glosses: to pound (to strike hard, usually repeatedly, f.ex. light, gun, beating, bombs)
to take something (a medicine, a drug, a cigarette etc.)
to make something (a cigarette, a picture, a poo etc.)

examples.text: Nudziło jej się, więc walnęła se jeszcze jeden obrazek.
examples.translation: She was bored so she made another picture.
examples.english: She was bored so she made another picture.

examples.text: Wyrzucił ramiona do przodu, uderzył Pozma w pierś, walnął pięścią w twarz
